info.title: poefilterx
info.description: Compiler and language server for PoeFilterX filters and filter stylesheets.

commands.description: Inspect which filter block and styles apply to a copied game item.

options.description: Full item text copied in game. Omit to paste at the prompt.

options.description: Poe1 or Poe2. [default: Poe1]
